anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: H701 reads 348.3 °C versus H702 at 53.4 °C and vessel at 43.3 °C, a persistent large disparity.
Over the last 120 s, H701 rises sharply from 348.3 to 381.4 °C while H702 falls to 52.9 °C and vessel temperature increases only to 44.1 °C.
Buffer differential pressure jumps from 2.0 to 5.7 mbar; system pressure drops from 298.5 to 293.9 mbar, while column differential pressure remains near zero.
Buffer differential pressure remains elevated at 5.0 mbar; system pressure is 296.6 mbar.

args.missing_evidence: Heater setpoints, power commands and safety limits; independent H701 temperature verification to distinguish actual overheating from sensor error; buffer pressure/valve/vacuum-system checks to explain the pressure change. No composition measurement or separation target is supplied.
